def test_process_exclude_patterns():
    config = ProcessorConfig(exclude_patterns=[r"SECRET", r"password.*"])
    proc = LogProcessor(config)
    assert proc.process({"level": "INFO", "message": "this is a SECRET message"}) is False
    assert proc.process({"level": "INFO", "message": "password is 123"}) is False
    assert proc.process({"level": "INFO", "message": "normal message"}) is True
